english.title: Attempt to solicit to commit murder
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to solicit, encourage, persuade, endeavour to persuade or propose to **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE PERSON..) to murder

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE INTENDED VICTIM..)]_

(C)_[persons unknown]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1 of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to solicit, encourage, persuade, endeavour to persuade or propose to murder another person

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The intended victim need not be identified; need not be a British subject or even be in the country. Solicitation against a particular class is sufficient.
(ii) Terrorist connection - this offence is listed in Schedule 1 to the Sentencing Act 2020. Where the court has determined that there is a terrorist connection, the court has to treat this as an aggravating factor in sentencing (section 69 of that Act) and the notification requirements under the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008 apply (section 42 of that Act). In addition, section 23A of the Terrorism Act 2000 provides for forfeiture of money or other property.

other.penalty:
